title: Vegan Day: Korean, Indian, and American-Inspired Meals (Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner)
summary: This Goodful video presents a single day of vegan cooking across three cultural influences—Korean, Indian, and American—with three hosts each preparing breakfast, lunch, and dinner that showcase vegan adaptations of familiar dishes. Dishes include yatijuku (Korean vegetable porridge) and a masala chickpea frittata for breakfast; bibbenguksu-like spicy Korean noodles and a dal-palak with quinoa for lunch; and a New England-style vegan clam chowder, shiitake bacon, a Korean mushroom hot pot, mutter paneer with cashew cream, garlic naan, and a meatloaf made with Impossible Meat for dinner. The lineup emphasizes pantry-friendly ingredients, plant-based protein sources, and traditional spice blends used in veganized formats, with notes on texture, mouthfeel, and regional flavors to guide viewers in recreating the meals at home.

sections.title: Yatijuku porridge (Korean vegetable porridge)
sections.description: Sora demonstrates a Korean-style vegan vegetable porridge by sautéing garlic in sesame oil, adding vegetables and rice, then simmering with water and gradually evaporating liquid. The dish is seasoned with salt and sesame seeds and finished with a seaweed garnish and extra sesame seeds.

sections.title: Masala chickpea frittata (vegan omelette)
sections.description: Chickpea flour batter is seasoned with turmeric and other spices, cooked with onions, then greens are folded in. The frittata sets on the stove and finishes under a broiler for crispness, topped with spiced yogurt and avocado.

sections.title: Cheesy vegan grits
sections.description: Creamy grits prepared with non-dairy milk, stirred to avoid lumps, enriched with nutritional yeast and vegan butter for a cheesy flavor; optional vegan cheese as a topping.

sections.title: PBenguksu (Korean spicy cold noodles)
sections.description: Noodles are cooked in boiling water, then rinsed under cold water to maintain chewiness. They’re tossed with a gochujang-based sauce and mixed with cucumber and cabbage, finished with kimchi, crispy seaweed, and sesame seeds.

sections.title: Dal palak with quinoa (lentil-spinach with quinoa side salad)
concepts: dal with cumin seeds, red chilies, hing
side salad with lime and chaat masala
sections.description: Lentils are cooked with aromatics and spices, then spinach is sautéed with onion, garlic, ginger and spices. Lentils and greens are combined, served with quinoa and a bright side salad.

sections.title: New England vegan clam chowder (oyster mushroom base)
sections.description: A vegan version of New England clam chowder uses oyster mushrooms to mimic clams, builds flavor with a wine deglaze and onion/carrot/celery soffritto, thickens with a flour roux, finishes with coconut milk and cashews, and boosts seafood-like depth with kelp granules.

sections.title: Shiitake bacon topping
sections.description: A quick shiitake bacon using a savory-sweet marinade, fried until crisp and used as a topping.

sections.title: Paso chongor (Korean mushroom hot pot)
concepts: kochikaru paste (Korean red chili flakes, soy sauce, garlic, cooking wine)
sections.description: A Korean mushroom hot pot assembled with a spicy paste and vegetable stock, featuring mushrooms, cabbage, watercress, and tofu arranged for communal, table-side cooking and eating.

sections.title: Mutter paneer (vegan) with cashew cream
concepts: turmeric, cumin, coriander, garam masala, red chili powder
sections.description: A vegan mutter paneer prepared with tofu, simmered in a spiced tomato base, finished with cashew cream and fresh cilantro; spices reinforce the dish's warmth and aroma.

sections.title: Naan with garlic pickle
sections.description: A simple accompaniment of whole wheat naan with garlic pickle to pair with curries.

sections.title: Meatloaf with Impossible Meat
concepts: glaze with ketchup, Dijon mustard, and brown sugar
sections.description: A meatloaf crafted with Impossible Meat and a flax egg, seasoned with onions, garlic, tomato paste, and spices, then glazed with a ketchup-Dijon-brown sugar reduction and baked until firm and flavorful.

sections.title: Closing
sections.description: There is a closing moment after the final dish; the transcript ends without further steps.
